s.en: I keep a little money in my pocket.
s.ko: 저는 주머니에 돈을 조금 넣고 다녀요.

s.en: I used all my money at the market yesterday.
My son will send me money next week.
s.ko: 다음 주에 아들이 저에게 돈을 보낼 거예요.

s.en: The old market only takes cash.
I paid in cash for the vegetables this morning.
I will get some cash from the bank later.
s.ko: 나중에 은행에서 현금을 좀 찾을 거예요.

s.en: My wife uses her card at the store.
I left my card at home yesterday.
The bank will send my new card next week.
s.ko: 다음 주에 은행에서 새 카드를 보내 줄 거예요.

s.en: I pay for fruit, and my friend pays for tea.
s.ko: 과일은 제가 내고 차는 친구가 내요.

s.en: My daughter paid for dinner last night.
I will pay with my card this time.
The cost of living is high in the city.
The cost of the meal was too high yesterday.
The cost will go up next year.
My grandson keeps old coins in a box.
s.ko: 손자는 오래된 동전을 상자에 모아 둬요.

s.en: I found a coin under the table this morning.
s.ko: 오늘 아침에 식탁 밑에서 동전을 하나 찾았어요.

s.en: You will need coins for the bus later.
s.ko: 나중에 버스를 타려면 동전이 필요할 거예요.

s.en: I visit the bank at the start of every month.
My husband waited at the bank for an hour yesterday.
s.ko: 어제 남편은 은행에서 한 시간 동안 기다렸어요.

s.en: The bank will close early tomorrow.
s.ko: 내일 은행이 일찍 문을 닫을 거예요.

s.en: You can get a refund at this store.
s.ko: 이 가게에서는 환불을 받을 수 있어요.

s.en: I got a refund for the broken cup yesterday.
They will give you a refund tomorrow.
I always keep the receipt in my wallet.
s.ko: 저는 항상 영수증을 지갑에 넣어 둬요.

s.en: The customer lost her receipt last week.
The store will give you a receipt.
My husband carries a brown wallet.
I left my wallet in the taxi yesterday.
My daughter is going to buy me a new wallet.
s.ko: 딸이 저에게 새 지갑을 사 줄 거예요.
